title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts so engineers can prototype agent workflows and tool integrations with minimal setup. This PR adds opinionated templates for common RAG patterns, a set of language-specific quickstarts that demonstrate tool calling (HTTP data fetcher, database lookup, and external function invocation), and the associated docs site updates. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (python/ts) - [x] Add tool-calling quickstarts and README examples - [x] Wire up docs site nav and sidebar entries - [x] Add sample eval prompts and a minimal integration test - [x] Run docs build and validate links Related: ENG-1428 (agent quickstarts initiative), DOCS-312 (docs site restructure). Usage: See docs/rag/quickstarts.md for step-by-step instructions. The python quickstart uses the redwood SDK and a small mock tool to demonstrate function/tool calling plus structured output validation. The TS quickstart demonstrates the same flow with the SDK-TS and a browser-friendly example. Docs: updated docs site with a new RAG section and added two quickstart pages; sidebar and search indexing updated. Examples: added redwood-examples/agents/tool_calling/* with detailed READMEs and run scripts. Tests: added a minimal integration test that runs the python quickstart against the local dev server (uses test fixture to mock the retrieval layer). CI: lint and unit tests passed; docs build succeeded. Migration notes: none. Rollout: examples and docs available immediately; no runtime code changes in serving runtime. If follow-ups are desired, see follow-up tasks in ENG-1439 (add more tool patterns) and DOCS-318 (add animated walkthrough).
